content: {"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站名称, code AS 厂站编码, kind AS 厂站类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3d FROM plant WHERE process = '氧化沟' ORDER BY code", "explanation": "直接在 plant 表中筛选处理工艺为氧化沟的厂站并列出名称、编码和规模。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站名称, capacity_m3d AS 设计处理规模_立方米每日 FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%南郑中心%' LIMIT 10", "explanation": "直接从 plant 表按厂站名称模糊匹配查询设计处理规模 capacity_m3d。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站名称, code AS 厂站编码, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_立方米每日 FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在集镇厂中按设计处理规模降序取第一条，得到规模最大的厂站。"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 鼓风机总台数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用台数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机'", "explanation": "统计设备台账中类型为鼓风机的总数及状态为备用的数量。"}
{"sql": "SELECT kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(rated_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device GROUP BY kind ORDER BY 设备数量 DESC", "explanation": "按 device.kind 分组统计设备台数并汇总额定功率。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, round(d.rated_kw::numeric, 1) AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 当前状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id ORDER BY d.rated_kw DESC NULLS LAST, d.code LIMIT 15", "explanation": "按额定功率从大到小排序列出设备台账，并关联厂站名称，取功率最大的前 15 台。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率, d.status AS 当前状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 100", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出设备编码与类型等信息。"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 厂站数量, sum(capacity_m3d) AS 设计规模合计_立方米每日 FROM plant", "explanation": "对 plant 表所有厂站的设计规模 capacity_m3d 求和并统计厂站数量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(r.mlss::numeric, 0) AS 污泥浓度MLSS_mg_L, to_char(r.ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS 采集时间 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "从分钟级实时表 plant_reading 中取协税镇污水站最新一条非空 MLSS 记录。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(r.inflow_m3h::numeric, 1) AS 进水流量立方米每小时, r.ts AS 采集时间 FROM plant p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, inflow_m3h FROM plant_reading WHERE plant_id = p.id ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站类型筛出中心厂，取每个厂在 plant_reading 中最新一条实时记录的进水瞬时流量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(lr.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区溶解氧_mgL, lr.ts AS 采集时间 FROM plant p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, do_aerobic_1 FROM plant_reading WHERE plant_id = p.id AND do_aerobic_1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) lr ON true ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "对每个厂站取 plant_reading 中最新一条有效的好氧区溶解氧（do_aerobic_1）实时值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, round(dr.current_a::numeric, 2) AS 电流A, dr.ts AS 采集时间 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, current_a FROM device_reading WHERE device_id = d.id ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) dr ON true WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND d.code = 'P01-BL-1'", "explanation": "按设备编码 P01-BL-1 定位中心厂1号鼓风机，取该设备最新一条监测数据的运行电流。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 昨日全区处理水量_m3, count(DISTINCT plant_id) AS 统计厂站数 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天全天（自然日）所有厂站小时表 inflow_m3h 之和，即全区总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(r.tn_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮_mgL, r.ts AS 采集时间 FROM plant p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT tn_out, ts FROM plant_reading pr WHERE pr.plant_id = p.id AND tn_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true ORDER BY r.tn_out DESC LIMIT 7", "explanation": "取各厂站最新一条实时监测数据的出水总氮，按由高到低排序，列出当前总氮最高的厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.blower_kw)::numeric, 2) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "取昨天整日的小时均值表数据，将中心厂鼓风机小时功率累加得到总耗电量（kWh，即度）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC", "explanation": "按本周起始时间（date_trunc('week', now())）至当前时刻汇总各厂小时表的进水流量，即各厂累计处理水量。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD日均值, round(avg(r.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮日均值, round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮日均值, round(avg(r.tp_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总磷日均值 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name","explanation":"筛选中心厂昨天整天的1小时均值数据，分别计算出水COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷的日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.cod_in)::numeric, 2) AS 进水COD平均值, count(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours' GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "取中心厂今天 0 点至 12 点的小时均值表，对进水 COD 求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL, round(avg(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 平均处理水量_m3h, count(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' AND r.hour < date_trunc('hour', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均进水氨氮_mgL DESC", "explanation": "查询最近24小时内 plant_reading_1h 按厂站分组求进水氨氮小时均值的平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 六天总处理水量, round((sum(r.inflow_m3h) / 6)::numeric, 1) AS 日均处理水量 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '6 days' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选梁山镇污水站 10月30日至11月4日共6个自然小时数据，累加小时处理水量后除以6得日均处理水量。"}

{"sql":"SELECT round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温, round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now());","explanation":"统计昨天自然日气象数据中的最低和最高气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 全区处理水量_m3, round((sum(blower_kw) / NULLIF(sum(inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天所有厂站小时表的鼓风机功率合计（即耗电量）和进水量合计，两者相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.ts < now() AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均污泥浓度_mgL DESC", "explanation": "plant_reading_1h 无 mlss 字段，故直接按厂站对最近7天原始数据中的 mlss 求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "取中心厂昨天各小时平均曝气风量的均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, to_char(pr.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') AS 小时, round(avg(pr.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND pr.hour >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND pr.hour < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name, pr.hour ORDER BY pr.hour", "explanation": "按厂站名称匹配协税镇，取 11 月 3 日当天（Asia/Shanghai 自然日）的小时均值表，按小时分组计算出水总磷 tp_out 的平均值。"}

{"sql":"SELECT round(sum(carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 2) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 2) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND hour <= now();","explanation":"汇总本周至今所有厂站小时表中的碳源和 PAC 投加量（kg/h 按小时累加即投加公斤数）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT to_char(hour, 'HH24:00') AS 小时, round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND hour < now() GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour", "explanation": "从小时聚合表按小时分组汇总今天 0 点至当前时段全区各厂站的处理水量（inflow_m3h 之和）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温_摄氏度 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "从气象表按天分组统计 11 月 1 日至 4 日的平均气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_立方米 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 处理水量_立方米 DESC LIMIT 3", "explanation": "按昨天整日筛选小时表，汇总各厂站处理水量并取前三名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(r.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 2) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3, round((sum(r.carbon_dose_kgh) / nullif(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 5) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 DESC", "explanation": "汇总过去7天各厂碳源投加量与处理水量，两者相除得到吨水碳源投加量并降序排列。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水COD, count(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() AND r.cod_out IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 平均出水COD DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂出水COD小时均值，按平均值降序取最高的一座厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, pr.hour AS 时间, round(pr.cod_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE pr.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND pr.cod_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pr.cod_out DESC LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "在最近7天的小时均值数据中按出水COD降序取第一条，关联厂站名称并显示时间与COD值。"}

{"sql":"WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', hour) AS day,
         sum(inflow_m3h) AS water
  FROM plant_reading_1h
  WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
    AND hour < now()
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 日期,
       round(water::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM daily
ORDER BY water DESC
LIMIT 1;","explanation":"统计最近7天内各自然日全区所有厂站的处理水量总和，并按水量降序取最大的一天。"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', r.hour))::date AS 日期,
  round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS "处理水量(吨)",
  round(sum(r.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS "鼓风机耗电量(kWh)",
  round((sum(r.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS "吨水曝气电耗(kWh/吨)"
FROM plant_reading_1h r
JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
WHERE p.kind = '中心厂'
  AND r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())
  AND r.hour < date_trunc('week', now()) + interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;","explanation":"按本周自然日汇总中心厂小时数据，用鼓风机耗电量除以处理水量得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS \"厂站\", round(sum(r.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS \"曝气耗电量(kWh)\", round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS \"处理水量(m³)\", round((sum(r.blower_kw) / NULLIF(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS \"吨水曝气电耗(kWh/m³)\" FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING sum(r.inflow_m3h) > 0 ORDER BY 4 ASC LIMIT 2;","explanation":"按本周小时数据汇总各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，计算吨水曝气电耗并升序取最低的两个厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, p.kind AS 厂站类型, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(r.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高出水氨氮_mgL, max(r.hour) AS 最近超标时间 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.kind ORDER BY 最高出水氨氮_mgL DESC;", "explanation": "统计过去7天内小时出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的厂站，并按最高值排序。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水平均总氮, round(max(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 最大小时均值总氮, count(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂最近7天的小时均值数据，统计出水总氮的平均值与最大小时均值。"}

{"sql": "WITH h AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, r.hour,
         (r.cod_out > 50 OR r.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR r.tn_out > 15 OR r.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR r.ss_out > 10) AS exceed
  FROM plant p
  LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h r
    ON r.plant_id = p.id
   AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
   AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
)
SELECT name AS 厂站名称,
       count(hour) AS 有效小时数,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE exceed) AS 超标小时数,
       count(hour) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE exceed) AS 达标小时数
FROM h
GROUP BY id, name
ORDER BY id;", "explanation": "以昨天自然日为范围，左连接各厂小时均值数据，按一级A标准（COD>50、氨氮最大值>5、总氮>15、总磷最大值>0.5、SS>10 任一超标）统计每厂超标小时数，无数据/无超标的厂也保留。"}

{"sql":"WITH p AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%黄官%'
), h AS (
  SELECT pr.plant_id, pr.hour, pr.nh3n_out_max
  FROM plant_reading_1h pr
  JOIN p ON p.id = pr.plant_id
  WHERE pr.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
    AND pr.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
)
SELECT p.name AS 厂站,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数,
       round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮_mg_L
FROM p
LEFT JOIN h ON h.plant_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name;","explanation":"筛选黄官镇厂站 11 月 4 日（昨天）的小时数据，用 nh3n_out_max>5 统计超标小时数，并取当日氨氮最高值。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, min(r.hour) AS 首次总磷超标时间 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND r.hour <= now() AND r.tp_out_max > 0.5 GROUP BY p.name;","explanation":"按小时数据筛选协税镇污水站本周内出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准（0.5 mg/L）的最早整点时间。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, round(max(dr.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动值_mm_s FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND dr.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.name, d.code, d.kind ORDER BY max(dr.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 5", "explanation": "统计最近7天各台鼓风机（device.kind='鼓风机'）振动速度有效值的最大值，按振动值降序排列，取第一行即振动最大的鼓风机。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS \"厂站\", d.code AS \"设备编码\", d.model AS \"型号\", d.rated_kw AS \"额定功率(kW)\", d.status AS \"状态\" FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY p.name, d.code;","explanation":"从设备台账中筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，并关联厂站表返回所属厂站。"}

{"sql":"SELECT count(*) AS "出水总磷超标小时数"
FROM plant_reading_1h
WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now())
  AND hour <= now()
  AND tp_out_max > 0.5;","explanation":"统计本周以来所有厂站小时数据中出水总磷最大值超过一级A标准 0.5 mg/L 的小时记录数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 设备型号, round(avg(r.current_a)::numeric, 2) AS 平均电流_安培, count(*) AS 运行采集点数
FROM device d
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
JOIN device_reading r ON r.device_id = d.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%'
  AND d.kind = '提升泵'
  AND r.running = true
  AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY d.code, d.model
ORDER BY d.code;", "explanation": "关联厂站、设备与设备监测数据，筛出中心厂提升泵昨天处于运行状态的记录，按设备编码分组求平均运行电流。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT dr.running) AS 停机分钟数 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name, d.code;","explanation":"筛选黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机在11月4日全天的每分钟设备数据，统计 running=false 的记录数即为停机分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 设备型号, round(avg(dr.temp_c)::numeric, 2) AS 平均温度_摄氏度, round(max(dr.temp_c)::numeric, 2) AS 最高温度_摄氏度, count(dr.temp_c) AS 有效读数条数 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id LEFT JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id AND dr.running AND dr.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '运行' GROUP BY d.id, d.code, d.model ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "从设备台账筛选中心厂状态为运行的鼓风机，关联过去24小时内运行状态的监测数据，按设备统计平均轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm每小时 FROM weather WHERE ts >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "在气象表 weather 中筛选 10 月 31 日全天数据，取降雨强度 rain_mm_h 的最大值即为当天暴雨峰值强度。"}

{"sql":"SELECT min(ts) FILTER (WHERE rain_mm_h > 0) AS 降雨开始时间, max(ts) FILTER (WHERE rain_mm_h > 0) AS 降雨结束时间, round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 当日降雨量毫米 FROM weather WHERE ts >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08';","explanation":"查询2026年10月31日气象数据中降雨强度大于0的最早和最晚时间，即为降雨起止时间。"}

{"sql": "SELECT min(dr.ts) AS \"首次超过7.1时间\" FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.code LIKE '%-BL-1' AND dr.vibration_mms > 7.1 AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now());", "explanation": "筛选2026年11月4日全天黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机振动大于7.1 mm/s的记录，并取最早发生时间。"}

{"sql":"WITH t AS (
  SELECT r.ts, r.do_aerobic_1, r.do_aerobic_2
  FROM plant_reading r
  JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
  WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%'
    AND r.ts >= timestamptz '2026-11-04 15:00:00+08'
    AND r.ts <  timestamptz '2026-11-04 18:00:00+08'
)
SELECT (SELECT name FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%黄官%' LIMIT 1) AS 厂站,
       round(min(do_aerobic_1)::numeric, 3) AS 好氧1号最低溶解氧_mgL,
       round(min(do_aerobic_2)::numeric, 3) AS 好氧2号最低溶解氧_mgL,
       round(least(min(do_aerobic_1), min(do_aerobic_2))::numeric, 3) AS 好氧区最低溶解氧_mgL,
       (SELECT to_char(ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM t WHERE do_aerobic_1 = (SELECT min(do_aerobic_1) FROM t) ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1) AS 好氧1号最低值时刻,
       count(*) AS 原始数据点数
FROM t","explanation":"按原始 5 秒~1 分钟数据筛选黄官镇污水处理站 11 月 4 日 15:00–18:00 的溶解氧记录，取好氧区 1、2 号 DO 的最小值及最低值出现时刻。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS \"厂站名称\", round(max(r.tp_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS \"出水总磷最高值(mg/L)\" FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'", "explanation": "筛选协税镇厂 11 月 3 日全天的 1 小时数据，取 tp_out_max 的最大值作为当天出水总磷最高值。"}

{"sql": "WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS d, max(rain_mm_h) AS max_rain
  FROM weather
  WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND ts < now()
  GROUP BY 1
),
top AS (
  SELECT d, max_rain FROM daily ORDER BY max_rain DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT to_char(top.d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 日期,
       round(top.max_rain::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h,
       round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 全区处理水量_m3
FROM top
JOIN plant_reading_1h r
  ON r.hour >= top.d AND r.hour < top.d + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY top.d, top.max_rain;", "explanation": "先在最近7天按自然日取气象数据最大降雨强度找出雨强最大的一天，再汇总该天各厂站小时处理水量得到全区处理水量。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now()) THEN '昨天' WHEN hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' THEN '前天' END AS 日期, sum(inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1) SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN 日期 = '昨天' THEN 水量 END)::numeric, 0) AS 昨日处理水量, round(sum(CASE WHEN 日期 = '前天' THEN 水量 END)::numeric, 0) AS 前日处理水量, round((sum(CASE WHEN 日期 = '昨天' THEN 水量 END) - sum(CASE WHEN 日期 = '前天' THEN 水量 END))::numeric, 0) AS 增加水量 FROM d", "explanation": "按自然日汇总全区各厂站 plant_reading_1h 的处理水量，计算昨天与前天的差值。"}

{"sql": "WITH daily AS (SELECT p.name AS 厂站, (h.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS 日期, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND h.hour >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name, (h.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) SELECT 厂站, round(max(CASE WHEN 日期 = DATE '2026-10-31' THEN 水量 END)::numeric, 0) AS 当日处理水量, round(max(CASE WHEN 日期 = DATE '2026-10-30' THEN 水量 END)::numeric, 0) AS 前日处理水量, round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = DATE '2026-10-31' THEN 水量 END) - max(CASE WHEN 日期 = DATE '2026-10-30' THEN 水量 END))::numeric, 0) AS 增加量 FROM daily GROUP BY 厂站;", "explanation": "按小时表汇总梁山镇污水站10月31日和10月30日的日处理水量，并计算两者差值。"}

{"sql": "WITH sludge_devices AS (
  SELECT p.name AS plant_name, d.id AS device_id
  FROM plant p
  JOIN device d ON d.plant_id = p.id
  WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵'
)
SELECT
  sd.plant_name AS "厂站名称",
  count(dr.ts) FILTER (WHERE dr.running) AS "运行分钟数"
FROM sludge_devices sd
LEFT JOIN device_reading dr
  ON dr.device_id = sd.device_id
 AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
 AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY sd.plant_name
ORDER BY sd.plant_name", "explanation": "按昨天自然日筛选各厂污泥泵的设备读数，统计 running=true 的分钟记录数，得到各厂污泥泵运行分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round((sum(r.inflow_m3h * r.tn_in) - sum(r.inflow_m3h * r.tn_out)) / nullif(sum(r.inflow_m3h * r.tn_in), 0) * 100, 2) AS 总氮去除率百分比, round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量立方米, round(avg(r.tn_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水总氮, round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水总氮 FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour < date_trunc('hour', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "取最近7天小时均值数据，按厂站以水量为权重计算进出水总氮负荷差与进水总氮负荷之比，得到总氮去除率。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, p.kind AS 厂站类型, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3d, round(coalesce(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0)::numeric, 1) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, round((coalesce(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0) / p.capacity_m3d * 100)::numeric, 1) AS 负荷率_百分比 FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h r ON r.plant_id = p.id AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.kind, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY 负荷率_百分比 DESC", "explanation": "以厂站为主表左连接昨日（前一自然日）的小时均值数据，汇总 inflow_m3h 得处理水量，再除以设计规模 capacity_m3d 得到负荷率百分比。"}

{"sql": "WITH stats AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, avg(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod
  FROM plant p
  JOIN plant_reading_1h h ON h.plant_id = p.id
  WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
    AND h.cod_in IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name
), region AS (
  SELECT avg(h.cod_in) AS avg_all
  FROM plant_reading_1h h
  WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
    AND h.cod_in IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.name AS 厂站,
       round(s.avg_cod::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水COD,
       round(r.avg_all::numeric, 2) AS 全区平均进水COD
FROM stats s
CROSS JOIN region r
WHERE s.avg_cod > r.avg_all
ORDER BY s.avg_cod DESC;", "explanation": "先按厂站统计过去7天小时表中进水COD均值，再计算全区同期平均进水COD，筛选出高于全区平均值的厂站。"}

{"sql":"SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN p.kind = '中心厂' THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS \"中心厂处理水量_m3\", round(sum(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 2) AS \"全区处理水量_m3\", round((sum(CASE WHEN p.kind = '中心厂' THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(sum(r.inflow_m3h), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS \"占比_百分比\" FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour <= now();","explanation":"统计过去7天各厂站小时处理水量，按中心厂与全区汇总后计算中心厂处理水量占全区百分比。"}
